text: Every IDEXX result comes to the ordering doctor as a task. Until it's marked reviewed, nobody should send it to the family.
Remember: Mark reviewed closes your task, and lets the team email IDEXX's report to the family.
When a result arrives, the ordering doctor gets a task. Abnormal and critical ones say so.
To review lists every complete result waiting for a doctor.
Each row says Partial or Final, and normal, abnormal or critical.
Values outside IDEXX's range are listed at the top.
Only out of range hides the rest.
VetConnect PLUS opens IDEXX's own view, with images and trends.
Medical note saves your read of the results on the chart.
When you've read it, click Mark reviewed.
It leaves To review, and your task closes. Under All recent,
open it again: your name and the time are on the result, and in Juniper's History.
A partial result can't be marked reviewed. Wait until it says Final.
The most common mistake: marking reviewed without opening the result. Remember: Mark reviewed closes your task, and lets the team email IDEXX's report to the family.
